title: Making ChatGPT better for clinicians
summary: OpenAI makes ChatGPT for Clinicians free for verified U.S. physicians, nurse practitioners, and pharmacists, supporting clinical care, documentation, and research.
body: OpenAI makes ChatGPT for Clinicians free for verified U.S. physicians, nurse practitioners, and pharmacists, supporting clinical care, documentation, and research.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布向美国认证的医生、执业护士及药剂师免费提供ChatGPT临床版。该工具旨在辅助临床护理、文档处理及医学研究，通过针对性的优化提升医疗专业人员的工作效率。原始信息显示：OpenAI makes ChatGPT for Clinicians free for verified U.S. physicians, nurse practitioners, and pharmacists, supporting clinical care, documentation, and research.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Making ChatGPT better for clinicians”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI针对医疗专业人员推出免费工具，标志着大模型在垂直专业领域的进一步落地。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
